job.title: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d) bei CGM – Koblenz

tailoring.headline: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud | SAP Certified Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant and Developer with 5+ years of experience bridging business and IT for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) architecture. Strong background in REST APIs, OCC, data integrations, and agile product delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and techno-functional consultant with over 5 years of enterprise platform delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in aligning business requirements with technical SAP Commerce solutions. Your Product Owner role for SAP Commerce Cloud is an exceptional fit for my background in managing integrations, translating business needs into user stories, and driving agile e-commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and technical teams, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Platform Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following best practices.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: Designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub while investigating integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) within agile delivery cycles.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional SAP Commerce expertise can contribute to your product team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Als SAP-zertifizierte SAP Commerce Cloud Entwicklerin und techno-funktionale Beraterin mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehende Expertise in der Anforderungsanalyse, der Erstellung von User Stories und der Steuerung komplexer E-Commerce-Projekte mit. Ihre Position als Product Owner für SAP Commerce Cloud passt perfekt zu meinem Profil an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Übernahme einer techno-funktionalen Rolle zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und technischen Teams: Analyse von Anforderungen, Erstellung von User Stories und funktionalen Spezifikationen sowie Übersetzung in SAP-Commerce-Lösungen.

bullets.label: Plattform-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwurf und Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement nach Best Practices.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenflüsse
bullets.text: Konzeption von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfoldern und DataHub sowie Analyse von Integrationsschnittstellen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und E-Commerce-Kanälen.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Erfassung und Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen gemeinsam mit Product Ownern und Fachabteilungen, Prozessmapping und Unterstützung von User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in agilen Teams.

cover_de.logistics: Ich befinde mich in einem festen Arbeitsverhältnis (letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026) und verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Ich freue mich auf das Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to drive impactful e-commerce solutions at CGM by combining my techno-functional SAP Commerce expertise, stakeholder management, and deep platform experience from global enterprises to shape scalable digital products.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce delivery and techno-functional analysis to drive product success as your SAP Commerce Cloud Product Owner.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, combining backend development and business analysis, I am very interested in your Product Owner role. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in techno-functional analysis, user stories, integrations, and SAP Commerce Cloud delivery.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
